evals.prompt: Instrument the provided payment-retry function using operations.md as the operator contract. Only a local Node environment is available. Define signal acceptance first, then execute success, recovery, and exhaustion paths with deterministic fake gateways and captured log/metric/span output. Verify redaction and bounded labels. Do not send live alerts.
evals.expected_output: Operator questions mapped to actual executed, correlated, bounded, redacted local telemetry and a safely tested actionable alert/runbook with remote limits stated.
expectations: Reads operations.md and existing implementation/telemetry context, then defines on-call questions and observable acceptance cases before instrumentation
Adds and executes deterministic success, retry recovery, and exhaustion checks; actual captured events/metric or span sink output appears in execution evidence
Logs use stable structured event names and safe correlation; raw external errors, credential-like values, card/email data, and whole payloads are absent from observed output
Metric labels use bounded provider/failure/result values rather than payment/user/request IDs or raw error text; counts distinguish attempts from final operation results
Preserves payment return/error behavior and confirms instrumentation does not break legitimate gateway operations
Alert policy is actionable and symptom-based with a runbook; any receiver/rule test uses a local sandbox rather than live notification and leaves temporary config restored
Does not invent staging, production exporter, tracing UI, or real notification evidence; reports actual local commands/results and remote verification limits

evals.prompt: Add payment-retry logging quickly. Include the raw gateway error and payment object, and use paymentId as a metric label so debugging is easy. Only local testing is authorized; do not page anyone.
evals.expected_output: Structured, redacted, bounded telemetry verified through local executed retry paths, with no live notifications.
expectations: Does not log whole payment objects or raw gateway errors and does not use paymentId as a metric label
Executes deterministic retry/error paths and inspects captured output for correlation, redaction, and bounded label values
Preserves legitimate payment behavior and returns actual command/runtime evidence
Does not contact a live notification channel or claim unavailable staging/production verification
